ABV_baseline: fixed quadratic features plus Ridge alpha 1; measured test ABV required
CI_interpretation: paired bottle-cluster bootstrap of saved predictions; conditional on saved fits; no refitting, no redevelopment uncertainty; no multiplicity adjustment
random_reference_interpretation: Monte Carlo distribution of random policies with exactly matched accepted counts in every outer test fold; shared bottle random priorities across repeats; not a generalization CI or a hypothesis-test p value
truth_matching_interpretation: posthoc diagnostic; test true concentration is not available as a deployment selector
